body.name: \(\rho_H,H_h,B_h,\pi_h,\nu_{P,h}\)
body.construction: \(\rho_H((x,z),(x',z'))=\|(x,z)-(x',z')\|_\infty\) when the two points are in the same connected component of \(H\), and \(\rho_H=+\infty\) otherwise. The finite set \(H_h\subset H\) obeys \(\sup_{w\in H}\min_{w_j\in H_h}\rho_H(w,w_j)\le h\); \(B_h=\{d:(d,z)\in H_h\}\). A Borel nearest-node map \(\pi_h:X_0\to B_h\) satisfies \(|x-\pi_h(x)|\le h\), with deterministic tie-breaking, and \(\nu_{P,h}=(\pi_h)_\#\nu_P\).
